must_identify.evidence: Pod shop/worker-7d568fdf96-rm2rj, container worker: restartCount: 1, lastState.terminated.reason: OOMKilled, exitCode: 137.

must_identify.item: The cause is a memory leak in the new worker code (items retained across batches in a list that is never cleared), not the batch size
must_identify.evidence: recent is never trimmed despite the comment calling it a "tail of recent batches" — it grows by ~5MB every 5s batch forever. ... No change to BATCH_SIZE (still 500), no change to the memory limit (192Mi)

notes: The RCA wrongly calls the leak a 'pre-existing bug' that a plain restart surfaced. In fact the worker.py in ConfigMap api-code was newly changed. It did not check the ConfigMap's change history, so its account of 'what changed' is inaccurate even though the mechanism and fix are right.
